official_results.finding: 9z won Inferno 13–11 and Nuke 13–1. Genuine upset, not proof that a repeat is more likely than not.
Falcons won Ancient 16–13 and Dust2 13–6. Ancient went to overtime.
Legacy won Dust2 13–11 and Mirage 16–14. A sweep can still be close.
FURIA won Ancient 13–10 and Mirage 13–9 despite trailing both first halves.
Aurora rebounded on Cache 13–9 and Dust2 13–7; NiP eliminated. Counter-evidence to an automatic Aurora fade.
9z took Mirage between losses on Nuke and Dust2. Falcons qualified. A credible upset case survives, but no arbitrary probability boost is added.
BetBoom reverse swept, winning Anubis 13–4 and Mirage 13–7. PARIVISION eliminated.
Legacy won Cache 13–10; FURIA answered with Inferno 13–5 and Mirage 13–8 to qualify. Losing to FURIA alone is not an upset signal.
